worktree_policy: read-only git worktree pinned to the authorized reviewed commit; the driver enforces HEAD == authorization.reviewed_correction_commit plus tracked+untracked cleanliness before any model exists (DATA-SOTA-379)
environmental_preflight: R2/DATA-SOTA-382: the driver resolves all 12 required entry points via importlib.metadata (missing/duplicated/out-of-root refuses), runs a bounded strong-extractor forward on the bound device, and binds the entry-point metadata digest into the executable identity
device_binding: R3/DATA-SOTA-383: --logical-slot verified against the operator's PRIVATE slot->physical binding (class + local identity) after CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; exactly one visible device; a real Conv2d forward/backward micro-preflight runs BEFORE custody reservation — failure refuses without spending an attempt
thermal_telemetry: tools/gpu_temperature_watchdog.py active on the executing host for the full cell duration
terminal_validation: custody verified_render(key) + cell record schema agent_multi.paired_sac_cell_record.v1 + attempt directory digest inventory + predeclared refusal taxonomy

sac.stopping: early patience 40 evaluations on the in-trial monitor; no monitor-based weight/architecture selection

envelope.source: ALPACA-frozen o2022 envelope from the B4 causal calibration (ATR 3.0/6.0), shared_execution_envelope plugin

evaluation.primary_endpoint: risk-adjusted scored-2022 return: mean per-bar log return / std of per-bar log returns (annualized sqrt(2190)), computed ONCE per arm-seed through the trial ledger
evaluation.dispersion: IQR of the paired differences across seeds

predeclared_refusals.minimum_activity: >= 12 position changes in the scored year, else the cell is ACTIVITY_REFUSED (excluded, reported)
predeclared_refusals.constant_policy_refusal: std of raw actions over the scored year < 1e-4 refuses the cell
predeclared_refusals.dead_actor_refusal: finding-235 family: zero action variance across distinct observations refuses the cell
predeclared_refusals.inconclusive: |paired effect| < 0.5 * std of paired differences, OR >= 2 seeds refused in any arm -> outcome INCONCLUSIVE; no reseeding, no post-hoc endpoint change
predeclared_refusals.no_selection: no outer-2024/sealed-2025 access; no monitor-driven weight choice; endpoints frozen by this design before any dispatch

trade_reconciliation: fill-truth with reconciling consuming join (gym-fx @e4ca6e8); single-population validated economics; epoch gate refuses disagreement
